entries.title: Gears of War
entries.definitive_edition: Gears of War: Reloaded on Windows

primary.why: The original game shipped on Xbox 360 and Windows, then received Ultimate Edition and Reloaded remasters. Gears of War: Reloaded is the highest-fidelity and most complete route because it offers 4K presentation, 60 fps campaign, 120 fps multiplayer, HDR/VRR/spatial audio, cross-play, and all Ultimate Edition post-launch DLC including the bonus campaign.
primary.how_to_play: Use Gears of War: Reloaded on Windows via Xbox app or Steam. Use the original Windows or Xbox 360 releases only for historical comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: lower fidelity than Reloaded and no sourced exclusive content over the remaster route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC release with bonus campaign content later preserved in remaster routes.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically important, but Reloaded includes the bonus campaign and modern presentation.
skip: superseded by Reloaded's newer platform and performance package.

all_releases.reason: skip: superseded by Reloaded on Windows.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern remaster route with 4K campaign target, 120 fps multiplayer target, HDR, VRR, spatial audio, cross-play, and all Ultimate Edition DLC.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity and completeness route.
skip: strong console route, but Windows has the broader capture/settings path.

all_releases.fidelity: First PlayStation release of the original Gears campaign.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive content over Windows Reloaded.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Reloaded is both the fidelity and completeness route for the first game's campaign and included remaster DLC.

entries.remaster_caveats: Reloaded is an updated remaster of Ultimate Edition, not a new sequel. Preserve original 2006/2007 releases only for historical comparison.

entries.title: Gears Pop!
entries.definitive_edition: No current playable definitive edition after service shutdown

emulation.notes: Live-service shutdown is the blocker, not emulation.

primary.why: Gears Pop! released on iOS, Android, and Windows 10. The service has a retirement/refund path, and it shut down on April 26, 2021. Windows 10 is the best archival/capture target, but the game is not currently playable through normal official service access.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route is available after the shutdown. Preserve only existing captures, metadata, and any legally retained local materials.

all_releases.reason: skip: service closed; no current official play route.
skip: service closed; no current official play route.

all_releases.fidelity: Retired PC live-service route; best archival capture target when historical access exists.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity archival target despite no current official service access.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows 10 is the archival fidelity target, but the live service is shut down, so completeness is limited to preserved materials rather than normal play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Retired online service; do not present as normally playable.
